surface: Waypoint component and position constants at react-waypoint 10.3.0, with vertical/horizontal geometry, offsets, ancestor selection, and rapid-crossing callbacks. Node and browser pristine/adapted runtime lanes plus repo-authored type lanes are registered with react-parity:check.
divergences: Public node and prop types use Octane structural types and do not import React.
waypoint-ref-child-contract: Octane's ref-as-prop model removes the upstream forwardRef detection branch and does not throw ensureRefIsUsedByChild when a custom child omits a ref.
waypoint-onenter-state-update: no class forceUpdate; adapted onEnter re-render smoke bumps useState instead.
A custom child must be supplied through the children prop so it remains an inspectable element descriptor; nested TSRX children compile to an opaque render block.
ssr: Supported. The marker renders on the server and measurement/listeners begin after client mount.
